title: Winter's Clutches
summary: Inflict Encrusted with Frost when you deal Cold damage.

fields.Winter’s Clutches: On Cold damage, inflict 2 turns of Encrusted with Frost on affected targets.
fields.Encrusted with Frost: Disadvantage on Dexterity saves. At 7 or more turns, the frost clears after a fixed DC 12 Constitution save. Reported behavior is Frozen for 2 turns on failure or 1d4 Cold on success, contrary to the tooltip. Burning removes the frost.
fields.Frozen: Incapacitated and vulnerable to Bludgeoning, Thunder and Force. Those damage types shatter it. Frozen grants Fire resistance and immunity to Burning and Encrusted with Frost.
fields.Acquisition: Glut’s reward and Lady Esther’s shop copy are mutually exclusive. A separate pair is on a counter near the elementals at Sorcerous Sundries.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
